_comment: Copy to config.json. Loaded at boot; absent file = defaults. NO SECRETS — tokens go in .env.
_atRestMode: The mode the room falls back to. MUST be the id of a mode that exists in your profiles store — the shipped starter store provides 'dining'. Change this only after creating the mode you name here, or the panic button has nowhere to go.

ha._note: tvs/lights are normally written by the setup wizard, not by hand. 'lights' is a FLAT list read by the Lights tab and POST /api/ha/lightscene; 'lightZones' is the named-zone map used by the Lighting lens. Both are live keys — an empty 'lights' makes POST /api/ha/lightscene answer 'no lights configured'. NOTE the setup wizard writes lightZones only, never lights — set that one by hand.

music.note: URL/token come from .env (MA_URL / MA_TOKEN); player picked in the app

auth._comment: RS-AUTH (SECURITY.md). enabled:false disables the admin-token gate entirely. tagOpen defaults to FALSE since v1.01: /api/tag/* needs the x-rs-token header like everything else — add it to your HA rest_command (docs/HA-SETUP.md). Set tagOpen:true ONLY if you cannot add the header, and understand that it lets anyone on the LAN launch any tagged mode.

_cors: cors omitted = no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (same-origin only — the default). Add "cors": "*" for the legacy wide-open behaviour, or an allow-list array like ["http://conductor.local:8090"]
_rooms: The app ALWAYS shows a synthetic first pill called 'This room'. Anything listed here is added after it, so do not add a room for the main wall or you get two pills for it. Leave this empty unless you genuinely have a second room.
